fields.title: ESPN betting record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType is ODDS for a sportsbook line, PROP for a player prop market, FUTURE for a season market, EVENT for a fixture, PREDICTOR for ESPN's own win projection, PROVIDER for a sportsbook, SURFACE for a reference probe and ERROR for a failure. An ODDS record with hasOdds=false is a fixture no book has priced yet - the source answered normally and had nothing to quote, which is different from a fetch that failed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The league that produced this record.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: espn-core-odds | espn-core-propbets | espn-core-futures | espn-core-events | espn-core-predictor | espn-core-providers | reference | error | none.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: ODDS | PROP | FUTURE | EVENT | PREDICTOR | PROVIDER | SURFACE | ERROR.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport as the source names it, e.g. football, basketball, soccer.

league.title: League
league.description: League slug as the source names it, e.g. nfl, eng.1.

leagueKey.title: League key
leagueKey.description: The league value you passed in.

eventId.title: Event ID
eventId.description: The source's fixture identifier. Stable, and the key to join records across modes.

competitionId.title: Competition ID
competitionId.description: Identifier of the contest within the fixture. Usually equal to the event ID.

eventName.title: Fixture
eventName.description: Full fixture name, e.g. 'Detroit Lions at Buffalo Bills'.

seasonType.title: Season type
seasonType.description: Source's season-type code, e.g. 2 for regular season.

week.title: Week
week.description: Week number, where the league has weeks.

homeTeam.title: Home team
homeTeam.description: Home team name. Null when the name lookup budget was spent or the league has no team list (UFC, golf, tennis) - the ID is still present.

homeTeamId.title: Home team ID
homeTeamId.description: Source identifier for the home team.

awayTeamId.title: Away team ID
awayTeamId.description: Source identifier for the away team.

hasOdds.title: Priced
hasOdds.description: False means the source answered normally with an empty provider list - the books have not posted a line for this fixture yet. It never means the request failed; failures are ERROR records.

providerName.title: Sportsbook
providerName.description: Sportsbook name, e.g. 'Draft Kings'. A fixture can carry a second entry for the same book's live in-play prices.

providerPriority.title: Sportsbook priority
providerPriority.description: The source's own ordering of sportsbooks; 1 is the primary.

isLiveOddsFeed.title: Live in-play feed
isLiveOddsFeed.description: True when this row is the sportsbook's live in-play feed rather than its pre-match board. Those rows carry a point spread but leave prices unset.

hasPlaceholderZeros.title: Placeholder zeros in source
hasPlaceholderZeros.description: True when the source wrote 0 in a price or total slot to mean 'not set'. Those fields are emitted as null so averages are not dragged toward zero; this flag tells you it happened.

details.title: Line summary
details.description: The line as the source writes it, e.g. 'BUF -5.5'.

spread.title: Spread
spread.description: Point spread relative to the home team; negative means the home team is favoured.

homeMoneyline.title: Home moneyline
homeMoneyline.description: American price on the home team to win outright.

awayMoneyline.title: Away moneyline
awayMoneyline.description: American price on the away team to win outright.

homeImpliedProbability.title: Home implied probability
homeImpliedProbability.description: Home moneyline converted to a probability, vig included - the two sides sum to slightly over 1 and the excess is the book's margin. Derived here; the source publishes prices only.

awayImpliedProbability.title: Away implied probability
awayImpliedProbability.description: Away moneyline as a probability, vig included.

openSpread.title: Opening spread
openSpread.description: Spread when the book opened the market.

openTotal.title: Opening total
openTotal.description: Total when the book opened the market.

closeSpread.title: Closing spread
closeSpread.description: Spread at close, once the market has closed.

closeTotal.title: Closing total
closeTotal.description: Total at close, once the market has closed.

spreadMovement.title: Spread movement
spreadMovement.description: Current spread minus opening spread. Derived here - the source publishes the two ends and not the difference.

totalMovement.title: Total movement
totalMovement.description: Current total minus opening total. Derived here.

favoriteFlippedSinceOpen.title: Favourite flipped
favoriteFlippedSinceOpen.description: True when the side the book favours today is not the side it favoured at open.

moneylineWinner.title: Moneyline settled
moneylineWinner.description: Whether the moneyline has settled in the home team's favour. Null before the fixture finishes.

spreadWinner.title: Spread settled
spreadWinner.description: Whether the spread has settled in the home team's favour. Null before the fixture finishes.

sportsbookUrl.title: Sportsbook link
sportsbookUrl.description: The source's outbound link to the sportsbook for this market.

propTypeId.title: Prop market ID
propTypeId.description: Identifier of the prop market type.

propTypeName.title: Prop market
propTypeName.description: Prop market name, e.g. 'Total Passing Yards (incl. overtime)', 'Anytime Touchdown Scorer'.

athleteId.title: Player ID
athleteId.description: Source identifier for the player the prop is on.

athleteName.title: Player
athleteName.description: Player name. Null if the name lookup budget was spent - the ID is still present.

currentTarget.title: Prop line
currentTarget.description: The number the market is set at right now, e.g. 257.5 passing yards.

openTarget.title: Prop opening line
openTarget.description: The number the market opened at.

targetMovement.title: Prop line movement
targetMovement.description: Current prop line minus opening line. Derived here.

lastUpdated.title: Prop updated at
lastUpdated.description: When the sportsbook last moved this prop.

marketName.title: Futures market
marketName.description: Season-long market name, e.g. 'Regular Season MVP', 'NFL - Super Bowl Winner'.

entityId.title: Runner ID
entityId.description: Source identifier of the player or team being priced.

entityName.title: Runner
entityName.description: Name of the player or team being priced.

price.title: Price
price.description: American price as the source writes it, e.g. '+400'.

impliedProbability.title: Implied probability
impliedProbability.description: The price as a probability, vig included. Derived here so runners priced +400 and -245 can be compared directly.

runnersInMarket.title: Runners in market
runnersInMarket.description: How many runners the sportsbook priced in this market.

homeWinProbability.title: Model: home win %
homeWinProbability.description: The source's own model projection for the home team, as a percentage. Compare against homeImpliedProbability x 100 to find fixtures where the model and the book disagree.

awayWinProbability.title: Model: away win %
awayWinProbability.description: Model projection for the away team, as a percentage.

homePredictedPointDiff.title: Model: predicted margin
homePredictedPointDiff.description: Projected points margin for the home team. Compare against the spread.

matchupQuality.title: Matchup quality
matchupQuality.description: The source's rating of how competitive the fixture should be.

statusDetail.title: Status detail
statusDetail.description: Human-readable status, e.g. 'Final', 'Thu, September 18th at 12:15 AM UTC'.

isAvailable.title: Source available
isAvailable.description: Reference records only: whether the source answered.

note.title: Note
note.description: Reference and unpriced-fixture records: what the source did, in words.

sample.title: Probe sample
sample.description: Reference records only: measured counts from the probe, including whether the source still behaves the way this Actor assumes.

winningTlsProfile.title: TLS profile used
winningTlsProfile.description: Which browser fingerprint the source accepted on this run.

errorReason.title: Error reason
errorReason.description: Error records only: short machine-readable reason.

errorDetail.title: Error detail
errorDetail.description: Error records only: the underlying failure.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: The line every sportsbook is showing, per fixture.

movement.title: Line movement
movement.description: How far the spread and the total have moved since the book opened.

modelVsBook.title: Model vs book
modelVsBook.description: The source's own win projection next to the price the book is offering.

props.title: Player props
props.description: Player markets with their opening and current lines.

futures.title: Futures board
futures.description: Season-long markets, sortable by implied probability.
